commits.messageBody:
daemon/test/api-routes.test.ts: one row per route (method, path, body)
against startApi on a testApp with fakes for claude, gh, launchd and
notifications, checking the status code and the answer's keys. Routes are
collected from src/api/routes/, so a route without a row fails, named by
its method and pattern; a route whose handler reads its body needs a 400
row too.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <person@example.com>
